dishwasher.title: 🍽️ Bowls on the top rack
dishwasher.a: You put the bowls on the top rack again. They never come out clean up there, that's what the bottom is for.
dishwasher.b: They fit fine up there and it leaves the bottom free for the pans. I've loaded it like this for years and nothing's come out dirty.

bill.title: 🍷 Splitting the restaurant bill
bill.a: I didn't drink anything, so I shouldn't pay a quarter of the wine. Splitting the food evenly is fine with me.
bill.b: We always just split it four ways. Working out who had what every time is a pain, and it's not much of a difference anyway.

thermostat.title: 🌡️ The thermostat war
thermostat.a: It's 19 degrees in here and I'm cold even in a hoodie. Turning it up to 22 isn't crazy.
thermostat.b: 22 is way too warm to sleep in. You can put on another layer, I can't take anything else off.

roadTrip.title: 🚗 Who drives home
roadTrip.a: I drove the whole six hours there. It's only fair that you drive us back.
roadTrip.b: I said before we left that I hate driving at night, and we're leaving at 7. I'll take the morning drives next trip.

seat.title: 💺 Reclining on a night flight
seat.a: My seat reclines, so I'm reclining it. It's a night flight and everyone's trying to sleep.
seat.b: I'm 6'3" and my knees are already pressed into your seat. You could at least ask before dropping it all the way back.

spoiler.title: 🎬 A spoiler for the finale
spoiler.a: You told me who the killer was before I'd even started the last episode. I'd been waiting all week for it.
spoiler.b: It came out three weeks ago and you said you'd finished it. I can't keep track of where everyone is.

jacket.title: 🧥 The borrowed denim jacket
jacket.a: You wore my denim jacket to the concert without asking. It came back smelling like smoke.
jacket.b: It was hanging by the door and you never wear it. I would've asked, but you were asleep and I was already late.

lastSlice.title: 🍕 Dibs on the last slice
lastSlice.a: I called dibs on the last slice before the movie started. Everyone heard me.
lastSlice.b: You can't call dibs and then not touch it for two hours. It was just sitting there going cold, so I ate it.

sundayPlans.title: 🛋️ A whole Sunday on the couch
sundayPlans.a: It's the only day we both have off and I'd like to go for a hike. Spending it all on the couch feels like a waste.
sundayPlans.b: I work hard all week and Sunday is when I recharge. We can hike next weekend, today I just want to do nothing with you.

anniversaryGift.title: 🎁 How much to spend on a gift
anniversaryGift.a: We agreed to keep gifts under 50 dollars, and you bought me a watch. Now I look like I didn't try.
anniversaryGift.b: I saw it and thought of you. It was on sale, and a number we picked years ago shouldn't stop me being generous.

couplePhoto.title: 📸 Posting our photo without asking
couplePhoto.a: You put our beach picture online and I hadn't even seen it yet. I look terrible in it and I'd have said no.
couplePhoto.b: I think you look great and I wanted to share a good day. I didn't know it would upset you this much.

phoneInBed.title: 📱 Phones in bed
phoneInBed.a: We get into bed and you scroll for an hour while I lie there. I'd like to talk, or at least go to sleep together.
phoneInBed.b: It's how I wind down after a long day. You're welcome to talk, but I don't want rules about a phone I'm just holding.

movieTurns.title: 🍿 Whose turn to pick the movie
movieTurns.a: I picked last time, and the time before. It's your turn, and you've just spent forty minutes saying nothing sounds good.
movieTurns.b: I'd choose if there were anything I wanted to watch. You always pick things I like less, so I stay quiet.

slowReply.title: 💬 Waiting hours for a text back
slowReply.a: I sent you a simple question at noon and heard back at eight. A quick reply wouldn't have cost you anything.
slowReply.b: I was in meetings all day and my phone was in my bag. It wasn't ignoring you, it just wasn't urgent.

bedSide.title: 🛏️ Whose side of the bed
bedSide.a: I've slept by the window for the whole six years. Now that we've moved, you took my side before I'd even unpacked.
bedSide.b: The bed is on the other wall in this room, so the sides flipped. I don't mind swapping back, I just didn't think about it.

surpriseParty.title: 🎈 A surprise party he didn't want
surpriseParty.a: I planned the whole thing for your birthday and invited everyone. You looked miserable the entire evening.
surpriseParty.b: I told you months ago that I hate surprises and big crowds. I appreciate the effort, but you didn't listen.

toothpaste.title: 🪥 Squeezing the toothpaste
toothpaste.a: You squeeze the tube in the middle and leave it flat and twisted. It's tiny, I know, but I find it every single morning.
toothpaste.b: It all comes out the same way in the end. I don't see why there's a right place to squeeze.

blanket.title: 🛌 The blanket thief
blanket.a: Every night you roll up in the whole blanket and I wake up freezing. It's like sleeping next to a burrito.
blanket.b: I get cold too and I don't do it on purpose. Maybe we could just get a second blanket instead of blaming me.

lateDinner.title: 🍝 Dinner at nine
lateDinner.a: You said you'd be home by six and walked in at nine. The pasta I made is cold and I've been starving.
lateDinner.b: A call ran long and I couldn't just hang up. I'd have let you know, but my phone died.

dateBill.title: 💳 Who pays on dates
dateBill.a: We've gone out a dozen times and you never reach for the bill. I'd like us to take turns.
dateBill.b: I make more than you right now and I'm happy to cover it. I didn't realise it bothered you, I just don't want to argue over a check.

quietHours.title: 🔇 Quiet hours after ten
quietHours.a: I have an early shift and I can hear your video call through the wall at eleven. I need you to keep it down.
quietHours.b: My team is in another time zone, so late is the only time it works. I'll use headphones, but you could use earplugs too.

fridgeShelf.title: 🧊 Whose shelf is this
fridgeShelf.a: I labelled my shelf in the fridge and you still put your leftovers on it. There's plenty of room on yours.
fridgeShelf.b: My shelf was full and your container was half empty. It's one night, I wasn't taking anything.

overnightGuest.title: 🚪 A guest who stays all week
overnightGuest.a: Your friend has stayed in the living room for six days now and nobody asked me. I'd like my apartment back.
overnightGuest.b: He's between places and has nowhere else to go. I told you he'd stay a few nights, and he's chipping in for groceries.

sharedShampoo.title: 🧴 Using my shampoo
sharedShampoo.a: My shampoo is a pricey one and it was nearly full on Monday. By Friday it's almost gone and you're the only other person who showers here.
sharedShampoo.b: I only used a little, twice. If it's that important, put it in your room, I thought bathroom things were shared.

dirtyPan.title: 🍳 The pan left to soak
dirtyPan.a: That pan has been in the sink since Tuesday and it's starting to smell. Whoever cooks should wash it.
dirtyPan.b: I was going to do it when it soaked a bit longer. You've left plates here for two days and I didn't say anything.

dryerLaundry.title: 🧺 Clothes left in the dryer
dryerLaundry.a: I came down and found my clean clothes in a pile on the table because you needed the dryer. They were still damp.
dryerLaundry.b: The cycle had been finished for an hour and I had a load waiting. Please just take your things out when the buzzer goes.

loudMusic.title: 🎧 Music through the wall
loudMusic.a: It's three in the afternoon on a Saturday and I'm in my own room. I don't think I should need headphones in my own place.
loudMusic.b: The bass shakes my desk when I'm trying to study. Nobody's asking you to stop, just turn it down a notch.

longShower.title: 🚿 Hot water running out
longShower.a: Your showers last forty minutes and the hot water is always gone when it's my turn. Ten minutes each would be fair.
longShower.b: I don't time myself and it's the only place I can relax. Maybe we could take turns going first.

lightsOn.title: 💡 Every light left on
lightsOn.a: I walk through and every light in the flat is on, even in rooms nobody's in. The bills are split, so it's my money too.
lightsOn.b: I like it bright and I walk in and out of rooms all evening. Switching them on and off all night is just as annoying.

parcels.title: 📦 Parcels piling up in the hall
parcels.a: There are six boxes of yours stacked in the hallway and I trip over them every day. Please bring them into your room.
parcels.b: I'm waiting to take them back to the post office and I've been busy. They've only been there four days.

houseplant.title: 🪴 Who waters the plant
houseplant.a: I bought the plant for the living room and I've watered it every week. Now it looks like a stick because you moved it to the dark corner.
houseplant.b: It was blocking the TV and I thought the corner was fine. I didn't know plants were that fragile.

lateArrival.title: ⏰ Forty minutes late again
lateArrival.a: We said seven and I sat in the restaurant alone until twenty to eight. This is the third time you've done it.
lateArrival.b: The bus was late and I texted you. You could have ordered a drink instead of being angry.

cancelledPlans.title: 🙅 Cancelling an hour before
cancelledPlans.a: I rearranged my whole day to see you and you cancelled with one message an hour before. It's not the first time.
cancelledPlans.b: I was exhausted and I'd have been terrible company. I thought it was kinder to say so than to drag myself there.

borrowedBook.title: 📚 A book that never came back
borrowedBook.a: I lent you that book last spring and it's been a year. It was signed, and I've asked you twice.
borrowedBook.b: I have it somewhere, I promise, probably in a box from the move. I'll find it, you don't have to keep bringing it up.

mutedChat.title: 🔕 Muting the group chat
mutedChat.a: You muted our group chat and missed the plan changing twice. We all had to wait for you at the wrong place.
mutedChat.b: It sends two hundred messages a day, mostly memes. I'd read the important ones if it didn't take an hour.

birthdayDinner.title: 🎂 Paying for the birthday dinner
birthdayDinner.a: It's my birthday dinner and the bill came to 90 each because of the expensive wine. I'd have thought the guest of honour wouldn't pay.
birthdayDinner.b: We always split everything evenly among the whole group, and everyone knows that. You picked the place, too.

plusOne.title: 💍 A plus-one at the wedding
plusOne.a: The invitation says my name only, but my partner of two years would be alone at home. I'm bringing them anyway.
plusOne.b: The venue has a hard limit and every seat costs us a lot. I'm sorry, but I can't make an exception for one person.

chargerBorrow.title: 🔌 The charger you borrowed
chargerBorrow.a: That's the third charger of mine that's gone missing at your place. I'd like them back, not another sorry.
chargerBorrow.b: They all look the same, so I honestly forget whose is whose. I'll bring a bag of them on Friday.

auxCord.title: 🎵 Who controls the car music
auxCord.a: I'm driving so I'm choosing the music. It's a long road and I'm the one who has to stay awake.
auxCord.b: You played the same album three times today. The passenger gets a say too, that's how every road trip works.

karaoke.title: 🎤 The song that wouldn't end
karaoke.a: You've sung nine songs and the rest of us have had one each. The mic is meant to go around the room.
karaoke.b: Nobody else put their name in the list, so I filled the gaps. Honestly, I thought everyone was enjoying it.

uninvited.title: 🙈 Left off the invite list
uninvited.a: I saw the photos from your party and I wasn't invited, although I've been to every one before. It really hurt.
uninvited.b: It was a small thing for my coworkers, just ten people. It had nothing to do with you, I didn't think you'd even want to come.

holidayHost.title: 🦃 Who hosts the holiday dinner
holidayHost.a: We've hosted the family dinner four years in a row. It's someone else's turn, and I'd love a holiday where I don't cook.
holidayHost.b: Mum can't manage the stairs and our place has the biggest table. Nobody else has offered, so I assumed we'd do it again.

dailyCalls.title: 📞 A call every single day
dailyCalls.a: Mum calls every day around six and expects a half-hour chat. I love her, but sometimes I'm just not up for it.
dailyCalls.b: She lives alone and that call is the best part of her day. You could tell her you'll text on the busy ones.

bedtimeKids.title: 🌙 Bedtime on school nights
bedtimeKids.a: Our son is eight and should be asleep at eight. You let him stay up for the football and now he's a wreck at school.
bedtimeKids.b: It was one match and he was so excited. A late night now and then won't hurt him, and it's special for him.

borrowedSweater.title: 👚 A sister who raids my closet
borrowedSweater.a: You took my green sweater without asking and wore it to a party. It came back stained and I'd never worn it.
borrowedSweater.b: I borrowed things from you my whole life and you didn't mind. I'll get it cleaned, but you're making it a big deal.

familyRecipe.title: 🥘 Grandma's recipe
familyRecipe.a: Grandma's soup always had a spoon of tomato paste, and it's in her handwriting. You left it out and called it the same recipe.
familyRecipe.b: I think it tastes lighter without it, and that's how I remember it. It's still her recipe, just slightly improved.

dadRide.title: 🚙 Driving Dad to the airport
dadRide.a: I drove Dad last time, and the time before that. Can you do the early flight this once instead of ordering a taxi?
dadRide.b: It's a two hour round trip and I have to be at work at six. I'll pay for the taxi, I just can't spare the time.

familyChat.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Chain messages in the family chat
familyChat.a: Uncle keeps forwarding those chain messages and videos to the whole family chat. I can't find anything real among them.
familyChat.b: He's only trying to be part of the group and share a laugh. Maybe a quick word, but muting him seems unkind.

tvRemote.title: 📺 Hiding the remote
tvRemote.a: Whenever I sit down for the match, the remote has vanished and a cartoon is on. This is the second time this week.
tvRemote.b: It's my favourite hour of TV and your match goes on all afternoon. We can take turns, but you can't take the whole afternoon.

seatingChart.title: 🍽️ Who sits at the end of the table
seatingChart.a: I've sat at that end for every family dinner since I was a kid. Now your boyfriend took it and nobody said anything.
seatingChart.b: He sat down first, and he's a guest. It's a chair, and we can swap places next time.

teenPhone.title: 🧒 Phone at the dinner table
teenPhone.a: Dinner is the one time we sit together as a family. Fifteen minutes without your phone isn't a big ask.
teenPhone.b: I'm only checking if a friend replied. You're on yours at the table too when work texts you.

meetingEmail.title: 📧 A meeting that could be an email
meetingEmail.a: We spent an hour on a call to hear what fit in three lines. That's an hour I could have spent finishing the report.
meetingEmail.b: Everyone's busy, but a call lets people ask questions on the spot. An email would have started five separate threads.

microwaveFish.title: 🐟 Fish in the office microwave
microwaveFish.a: You heated salmon in the shared microwave and the whole floor smells like it until three. Please bring something else.
microwaveFish.b: It's my only proper lunch and I don't have a lot of money for takeaway. Other people heat curry and nobody says a word.

stolenLunch.title: 🥪 Someone ate my lunch
stolenLunch.a: My name was on the bag and the sandwich was gone by noon. I'm guessing you saw who took it.
stolenLunch.b: I didn't see a thing, and I don't want to accuse anyone. Maybe a note on the fridge is a kinder first step.

replyAll.title: 📨 Reply all to the whole company
replyAll.a: You replied to everyone, all two hundred people, with 'thanks!' Now my inbox has forty more of those.
replyAll.b: I wanted to be polite and the button was right there. It's a tiny mistake, and nobody's actually harmed.

officeCold.title: ❄️ The icy office
officeCold.a: The air conditioning is set so low that I wear a coat at my desk in July. A few degrees warmer wouldn't hurt anyone.
officeCold.b: I run hot and the sun hits my side all afternoon. If you're cold, a blanket is easier than sweating for the rest of us.

openOfficeHeadphones.title: 🎧 Headphones in the open office
openOfficeHeadphones.a: I'm wearing headphones to focus, and people tap me every few minutes with a quick question. It breaks my train of thought.
openOfficeHeadphones.b: It's hard to know if you're really busy. A message first would be too slow when the answer takes ten seconds.

emptyCoffee.title: ☕ The last cup of coffee
emptyCoffee.a: You poured the last of the pot and left the empty one on the burner. A new pot takes two minutes.
emptyCoffee.b: I was late for a call and honestly didn't notice it was the last cup. I'll make the next one, I promise.

ideaCredit.title: 💡 Whose idea was it
ideaCredit.a: I suggested the new schedule in March and you presented it to the boss as yours. A thank-you would have been enough.
ideaCredit.b: We talked it over together and I developed it with the team. I thought we all agreed it was shared work.

fridayDeadline.title: 📅 A deadline set for Friday
fridayDeadline.a: You said you'd send me your part by Friday and it's Monday. Everyone else was waiting on this, and I had to ask twice.
fridayDeadline.b: A bigger project landed on me and I had to choose. I should have told you earlier, but it will be with you today.

deskLunch.title: 🥗 Lunch at the desk
deskLunch.a: Nobody on this team takes a real lunch break anymore, and it's starting to feel expected. I'd like us to step away at noon.
deskLunch.b: I eat while I work and go home earlier because of it. Breaks are fine, but I'd rather decide for myself.

calendarInvite.title: 🗓️ Meetings with no agenda
calendarInvite.a: Your invite said 'catch up' with no agenda and took forty-five minutes of my morning. Please tell me what it's about first.
calendarInvite.b: It was meant to be a chat, and we ended up solving two problems. A formal agenda would have killed the conversation.

rentSplit.title: 🏠 Splitting the rent by room size
rentSplit.a: My room is the smallest and has no closet, but I pay the same as you. I think the biggest room should cost more.
rentSplit.b: We agreed on equal thirds when we signed the lease. Redoing the numbers every time one of us has a feeling gets messy.

smallLoan.title: 💵 Ten dollars from lunch
smallLoan.a: I covered your lunch last month and again last week. It adds up to thirty, and I haven't heard a word about it.
smallLoan.b: I thought we were even after the coffee run. I don't mind paying, just tell me the number and I'll send it today.

tipping.title: 🧾 How much to tip
tipping.a: The service was slow and the food was cold. I'm leaving ten percent, not twenty.
tipping.b: The place was packed and the waiter was clearly overwhelmed. Tips matter a lot to them and it's not much extra for us.

streamingShare.title: 📺 Sharing a streaming account
streamingShare.a: I pay for the streaming plan and now half of your friends use it too. I'd like them to chip in or get their own.
streamingShare.b: It costs the same whether two or five people use it. Asking for a few dollars each would just be awkward.

taxiSplit.title: 🚕 Splitting the taxi home
taxiSplit.a: Your stop was the first one and mine was fifteen minutes further, yet we split the fare in half. I'd call that not quite fair.
taxiSplit.b: We shared the same car and we left together. Working it out per mile for twenty dollars is a bit much.

groupGift.title: 🎀 The group gift
groupGift.a: Everyone is chipping in twenty for our teacher's gift, but I'm a student and that's a lot to me. Can I give ten?
groupGift.b: The gift is already ordered at that price, and a smaller share means someone else covers it. I get it, but it's awkward.

groceryList.title: 🛒 Splitting the groceries
groceryList.a: You buy snacks and fancy cheese and add it to the shared total. I only eat the basics, so I shouldn't pay half.
groceryList.b: You're welcome to eat the cheese anytime. It was a shared bill from the start and I'm not keeping a spreadsheet.

bigPurchase.title: 🛍️ A big purchase without a word
bigPurchase.a: You bought a new gaming monitor for 400 dollars on the same week we were saving for the trip. You could have asked me.
bigPurchase.b: It came out of my own spending money, and I've been waiting for it for a year. I didn't think I needed permission.

subscriptions.title: 💳 Cancelling forgotten subscriptions
subscriptions.a: We pay for four apps neither of us opens. Let's cancel them and put the money toward the holiday.
subscriptions.b: I'm sure I'll use at least two of them soon. Can we keep them until the end of the month before we decide?

restaurantChoice.title: 🍜 Where to eat tonight
restaurantChoice.a: I said ramen three times this week and you said sure every time, then picked something else. I'd like us to go.
restaurantChoice.b: I wasn't in the mood for noodles when we got there. Next time say a place and I'll commit before we leave.

cerealMilk.title: 🥣 Milk before the cereal
cerealMilk.a: You pour the milk first and then add the cereal. It's wrong, and it gets soggy before you finish.
cerealMilk.b: I like it that way and I eat it right away. You don't have to watch, just let me enjoy my breakfast.

ketchup.title: 🍳 Ketchup on the eggs
ketchup.a: You put ketchup on a perfectly cooked omelette. That's a waste of good eggs, and I can't watch.
ketchup.b: I've eaten them like this since I was a kid and I like the taste. It's my plate, you eat yours however you want.

pizzaCrust.title: 🍕 Leaving the pizza crust
pizzaCrust.a: You eat the middle and leave the crust on the plate every time. That's the best part and it's going in the bin.
pizzaCrust.b: The crust is hard and I'm full by then. If you want it, take it, I'm not going to force myself.

coffeeTea.title: ☕ Coffee or tea in the morning
coffeeTea.a: You said tea is just hot leaf water, then asked for a sip of my coffee. I'd like an apology.
coffeeTea.b: I like coffee smell more than coffee taste. And I drink tea because it's calm, I don't need to be convinced.

spiceLevel.title: 🌶️ How spicy is too spicy
spiceLevel.a: You asked for 'mild' and then dumped half the chili oil on your plate. Now the whole table is coughing.
spiceLevel.b: Mild for me isn't mild for you, and I didn't know the table was sharing. I'll order a separate bowl next time.

leftovers.title: 🥡 Throwing out the leftovers
leftovers.a: I was saving that curry for lunch and you threw it out because it had been in the fridge two days. It was fine.
leftovers.b: I thought it had been there far too long, and I didn't want anyone getting sick. I'll replace it, I'm sorry.

cilantro.title: 🌿 Cilantro in everything
cilantro.a: You've put cilantro in the dish again, even though you know it tastes like soap to me. I can't pick it all out.
cilantro.b: The recipe calls for it and the dish needs the freshness. Next time I'll leave it in a bowl on the side.

tooSalty.title: 🧂 Too much salt in the soup
tooSalty.a: You salted the soup before tasting it and now it's too salty to eat. I'd like to start over with a fresh pot.
tooSalty.b: It tastes right to me, and I always add salt at the end. Stir in some water, it's easy to fix.

doubleDip.title: 🥨 Double-dipping at the party
doubleDip.a: I saw you bite a chip and dip it again in the shared bowl. Now I don't want anything from it.
doubleDip.b: It was one dip and nobody else saw it. You're making it into something huge, just get a clean spoon.

pastaShape.title: 🍝 Pasta that isn't spaghetti
pastaShape.a: This sauce is meant for long noodles, and you made it with short ones. It's simply not the same dish.
pastaShape.b: We only had penne in the cupboard, and it tastes fine. Does it matter that much what shape it is?

hotdog.title: 🌭 Is a hot dog a sandwich?
hotdog.a: A hot dog is a filling inside sliced bread, so it's a sandwich. End of story.
hotdog.b: It's its own thing. Nobody orders a sandwich and expects a hot dog, and no menu lists it under sandwiches.

trashDay.title: 🗑️ Taking the trash out
trashDay.a: The bin has been overflowing since Wednesday and I've taken it out the last four times. It's your turn.
trashDay.b: I take out the recycling and the compost, and those count too. Let's make a proper rota so we stop counting.

foldTowels.title: 🧺 The right way to fold towels
foldTowels.a: I just refolded all the towels in thirds because you fold them in half and they don't fit on the shelf.
foldTowels.b: They're towels and they get used in a minute. I'm not going to learn a folding system for them.

vacuumSchedule.title: 🧹 How often to vacuum
vacuumSchedule.a: I vacuum twice a week and I've never seen you touch it. A bit of hair on the floor really does get to me.
vacuumSchedule.b: It looks fine to me once a week, and you're doing it more than needed. I'm happy to do Sundays if you leave the rest.

whoCooks.title: 🍲 Cooking every night
whoCooks.a: I've cooked dinner five nights out of seven this month. I'd like to share the cooking more evenly.
whoCooks.b: I'm not as good at it and you enjoy it more. But you're right, let's pick two nights and I'll improve.

makeBed.title: 🛏️ Making the bed
makeBed.a: You get up, leave the covers in a pile and say there's no point since we'll just mess it up again tonight. It makes the room look messy.
makeBed.b: I'm the one who leaves first for work, and it takes two minutes I don't have. If it matters so much to you, do it when you get up.

toiletSeat.title: 🚽 The toilet seat
toiletSeat.a: I've walked into the bathroom in the dark three times and the seat was up. Putting it down is not hard.
toiletSeat.b: Leaving it up is less to touch, and I'm not thinking about it at midnight. If it's bothering you, I'll try to remember.

toiletPaper.title: 🧻 Over or under
toiletPaper.a: The roll goes with the paper coming over the top. You hung it backwards and I have to reach around every time.
toiletPaper.b: It makes no difference to how it works, so pick whichever you like. I'm not rehanging it just to match your habit.

laundryColours.title: 👕 Mixing colours in the wash
laundryColours.a: My white shirt came out of the wash pink because you threw in the red towel. That's a shirt I wore to work.
laundryColours.b: I was in a rush and a small load takes too long. I'll buy you a new one, but it was an honest mistake.

washCar.title: 🚗 Cleaning the shared car
washCar.a: The back seat is full of wrappers and a coffee cup from last week. We share the car so we should share the cleaning.
washCar.b: I clean the car whenever it's close to a mess. I didn't think a few wrappers counted, I'll do it this weekend.

beachOrCity.title: 🏖️ A beach or a city break
beachOrCity.a: I want a week lying by the sea, nothing planned. We spent our last trip walking round museums.
beachOrCity.b: I get bored after two days on a sun lounger. I'd like to see something new, even if we only do half the city.

airportEarly.title: ✈️ How early to reach the airport
airportEarly.a: Three hours before the flight is far too early. We'll just be sitting at the gate with a coffee for ages.
airportEarly.b: Queues can be long and I'm a nervous flyer. I'd rather wait than rush, and missing the flight would cost a lot more.

campingHotel.title: ⛺ A tent or a hotel
campingHotel.a: I booked us a campsite for the weekend and you're now saying you'd rather stay in a hotel. We agreed on this in spring.
campingHotel.b: The forecast says rain the whole weekend and a wet tent isn't relaxing. I'd happily go camping when the weather is better.

packingLight.title: 🧳 One suitcase each
packingLight.a: We agreed to carry-on bags only and yours weighs a ton. You've got three pairs of shoes in there.
packingLight.b: I like having options and you packed a coat you won't need. If we pay for one checked bag, I'll cover it.

mapOrGps.title: 🗺️ Trusting the GPS
mapOrGps.a: The map app said to go left and you turned right, because you think you know a shortcut. We've lost twenty minutes.
mapOrGps.b: I've driven this road a hundred times and the app doesn't know about the roadworks. I was right the last time.

leaveTime.title: 🕗 What time to leave
leaveTime.a: I said we should leave at eight to beat the traffic and you're still in the shower at eight thirty. This always happens.
leaveTime.b: The party starts at ten, so leaving at eight is way too early. You plan for the worst traffic and then I'm the one who ends up rushing.

sleepIn.title: 🌅 Weekend wake-up time
sleepIn.a: It's Saturday and you're up at six making noise in the kitchen. The one morning I can sleep in, and it's gone.
sleepIn.b: My body wakes up early and I was trying to be quiet. Lying there staring at the ceiling isn't helping either.

dinnerReservation.title: 🕰️ Booking the dinner table
dinnerReservation.a: You booked the table for half past five and it's a Friday. Nobody eats that early, and I'd made other plans.
dinnerReservation.b: It was the only slot left and I'd have lost it. I did ask you, but you were busy and didn't answer.

boardGameRules.title: 🎲 Rules nobody remembers
boardGameRules.a: You've been playing this game wrong the whole evening and now you're winning. I'd like to go back and replay the turns.
boardGameRules.b: We read the manual together at the start and nobody objected. You can't change the rules when you're losing.

houseRules.title: 💰 House rules in Monopoly
houseRules.a: I put the fine money in the middle, so the next person to land on Free Parking wins it. That's the real rule.
houseRules.b: The rulebook doesn't say that, and it makes the game last all night. Let's play it as it's printed.

fantasyTrade.title: 🏈 An unfair fantasy trade
fantasyTrade.a: You traded me an injured player for my best runner, and I said yes without checking. It's an unfair trade, so let's undo it.
fantasyTrade.b: You agreed in writing and the deal was fair when we made it. Checking is your job, not mine.

lineCall.title: 🎾 Out or in
lineCall.a: That ball was clearly out and you've been saying it was in for the whole match. I'd like the point replayed.
lineCall.b: I was closer to the line and I saw it clip the edge. You can't call it from the other end of the court.

controllerTurns.title: 🎮 Whose turn on the controller
controllerTurns.a: You've had the controller for an hour and every time I ask you say 'one more round'. That's not how turns work.
controllerTurns.b: I was in the middle of a level and couldn't stop. I'm giving it to you right after this one, I promise.

teamCaptain.title: ⚽ Picking the teams
teamCaptain.a: You picked all your friends first and left me with the weaker players again. I'd like the teams to be balanced.
teamCaptain.b: We played this way for years and you've never complained. If you want fair teams, shuffle them by drawing names.

cardCheating.title: 🃏 A card that was hidden
cardCheating.a: I saw you take a card from the bottom of the deck during the last hand. If that's how you win, I'm done playing.
cardCheating.b: I dropped one and picked it up, that's all. You've been grumpy about losing all night, and now you're accusing me.

trashTalk.title: 🏀 Trash talk on the court
trashTalk.a: A little teasing during the game is part of the fun. You went quiet and sulky after one comment, and I only joked.
trashTalk.b: It's one thing when you joke about the game, another when it's about me. I just want us to keep it kind.

gameSave.title: 💾 Writing over the save file
gameSave.a: I spent thirty hours on that save file and you started a new game on top of it. Now it's gone.
gameSave.b: There was only one slot and it looked unused. I'd have asked, but you weren't home and I only wanted to try it.

loserPays.title: 🎳 Loser pays for the pizza
loserPays.a: We said loser pays, and you lost by two pins. A deal is a deal, so please get your wallet out.
loserPays.b: I said it as a joke and I thought you knew that. I'll buy the next round if you'd rather it be that.

pickleball.title: 🏓 Who keeps score
pickleball.a: I counted eight to six, and you say it's seven all. We keep forgetting the score and it ruins the game.
pickleball.b: I've been counting every serve and I'm sure of it. Let's just call a replay point and keep going.

dogCouch.title: 🐕 The dog on the couch
dogCouch.a: We said no dogs on the couch, and I come home to find him spread out on it. The cushions are covered in hair.
dogCouch.b: He looks so happy and he's only there while we watch TV. The cover is washable, and it makes him part of the family.

walkingDuty.title: 🦮 Who walks the dog
walkingDuty.a: I've done the morning and evening walks since the weekend and I have a presentation tomorrow. It's your turn tonight.
walkingDuty.b: It's pouring and I've just sat down. I'll take the long walk on Saturday, can't we skip tonight?

catNames.title: 🐈 Naming the new kitten
catNames.a: I found her and I'm calling her Biscuit. Your name for her is Sir Fluffington, and I won't say that to a vet.
catNames.b: It makes me laugh every time and she answers to it already. Biscuit is nice but everyone's cat is called that.

catKeyboard.title: 🐱 The cat on the work desk
catKeyboard.a: She walks across my keyboard during meetings and you encourage it with treats. Now she thinks my desk is her bed.
catKeyboard.b: Everyone on the call loves her, and she's only looking for company. You can shut the door if it bothers you.

feedingTime.title: 🥫 Feeding the cat twice
feedingTime.a: I gave the cat her dinner at six and you fed her again at seven. She's getting a little chubby.
feedingTime.b: She was meowing at me and I thought no one had fed her. A note on the fridge would stop this.

vetCosts.title: 🐾 Sharing the vet bill
vetCosts.a: The vet bill was 280 dollars and I paid it all because I booked it. You adopted the dog with me, so we should split it.
vetCosts.b: I'd have paid if you'd told me before the appointment. Send me the receipt and I'll transfer half.

offLeash.title: 🌳 Off the leash at the park
offLeash.a: Your dog ran up to my puppy without warning and he's nervous. The sign says leashes are required in this area.
offLeash.b: He's friendly and only wanted to say hello. I keep him close, and everyone else here lets theirs off.

petInBed.title: 🐶 The dog in the bed
petInBed.a: He takes up half the mattress and I wake up with a paw in my face. I'd like to have the bed to ourselves again.
petInBed.b: He's anxious on his own and sleeps better next to us. I'd rather lose some space than hear him cry all night.

puppyName.title: 🐕‍🦺 Picking the puppy's name
puppyName.a: We've been calling him 'the pup' for a week because we can't agree. I vote for Rocket and it fits him perfectly.
puppyName.b: He's calm and slow, so Rocket sounds silly. I like Pepper, and it suits his freckles.

fishSitter.title: 🐠 Who feeds the fish
fishSitter.a: I asked you a month ago to feed the fish while we're away. You say you forgot to sort it, and the trip is tomorrow.
fishSitter.b: I thought your neighbour offered, and I didn't want to double up. I can ask my sister tonight, she lives close.

birdNoise.title: 🦜 The parrot that never stops
birdNoise.a: Your parrot squawks at six every morning and I can't get back to sleep. I live right next to you.
birdNoise.b: He's a bird and he's greeting the sun. I'll move the cage to a quieter room, I'm sorry about it.

wifiPassword.title: 🔐 Giving out the wifi password
wifiPassword.a: You gave the wifi password to everyone who came over, and now it's slow when I work. I'd like to change it.
wifiPassword.b: It's rude to refuse guests, and nobody's really using that much. If it bothers you, make a guest network.

tvVolume.title: 🔊 The volume war
tvVolume.a: You watch everything at volume 40 and I can hear every word of it from the kitchen. Please use the subtitles.
tvVolume.b: I don't hear well, and I miss the dialogue on the lower settings. Subtitles make me read, not watch.

phoneAtDinner.title: 📵 Phones on the restaurant table
phoneAtDinner.a: We were out for our first night in a month and you checked your phone every five minutes. I felt like I was sitting alone.
phoneAtDinner.b: I was waiting on a message about my brother's flight landing. I should have said so, but I didn't want to worry you.

notificationSound.title: 🔔 Notification sounds in the library
notificationSound.a: Your phone dings every thirty seconds and some of us are studying. Please switch it to silent.
notificationSound.b: It's on vibrate now, and I'm very sorry. I didn't notice that the sound was on, so it won't happen again.

darkMode.title: 🌗 Dark mode or light mode
darkMode.a: You switched the shared tablet to light mode at night and it burns my eyes. We agreed on dark in the evening.
darkMode.b: I can't read anything in dark mode, the text gets blurry. I'll switch it back before bed, but I need it in daytime.

smartSpeaker.title: 🗣️ The smart speaker that listens
smartSpeaker.a: You put a smart speaker in our bedroom and I'm uncomfortable with it listening. I'd like it moved to the kitchen.
smartSpeaker.b: I only use it for alarms and the weather. The kitchen is too far, but I can mute the microphone at night.

tabsOpen.title: 🗂️ Two hundred open tabs
tabsOpen.a: Whenever I borrow your laptop there are a hundred tabs open and it crawls. Closing a few would make it faster.
tabsOpen.b: Every one of those is something I need, and I know exactly where each one is. It's organised chaos.

photoStorage.title: 🖼️ Sharing the cloud storage
photoStorage.a: Your videos have filled our shared storage and I can't back up my photos. Please delete some, or pay for your own.
photoStorage.b: They're all family videos and I don't want to lose them. I'll move them to a drive, but give me a few days.

videoCallCamera.title: 📹 Camera on for video calls
videoCallCamera.a: Our weekly family call is the only time we see each other, and you keep your camera off. It's like talking to a wall.
videoCallCamera.b: I'm usually cooking or in my pyjamas. I'm still there and listening, and I don't think the camera is the point.

doorbellCamera.title: 🚪 The doorbell camera
doorbellCamera.a: You installed a camera that watches the whole front walk, and the neighbours can see it too. I'd like it angled away.
doorbellCamera.b: We had two packages stolen last winter, and it only records our own porch. I'm happy to tilt it down a bit.

holdDoor.title: 🚪 Holding the door
holdDoor.a: I held the door for a whole group, and not one of them said thank you. It takes a second to be polite.
holdDoor.b: People are in a hurry and don't always notice. You should do it because it's kind, not because you expect thanks.

elevatorSpot.title: 🛗 Standing in front of the elevator
elevatorSpot.a: I was waiting for the lift and you pushed in right when it opened. I was clearly there first.
elevatorSpot.b: I had a stroller and the lift was the only way for me. I didn't see you, I'm sorry, but I really needed it.

cuttingQueue.title: 🧍 Cutting the line
cuttingQueue.a: You walked straight to the counter while the rest of us waited for twenty minutes. There's a queue behind me.
cuttingQueue.b: I only need to ask a quick question and I wasn't ordering. I didn't realise this was the line for it.

busPhone.title: 🚌 A loud call on the bus
busPhone.a: The man behind me has been on speakerphone for twenty minutes and we've all heard his whole day. A headset would be kind.
busPhone.b: It's an urgent call and the line is bad, so I need the speaker. I'll keep it short, there's no need to be rude.

shoesInside.title: 👟 Shoes in the house
shoesInside.a: Please take your shoes off at the door, we don't wear them inside. I've just cleaned the floor.
shoesInside.b: It's a dry day and the soles are clean. I'm not used to it, but I'll take them off if it matters that much.

armrest.title: 💪 Sharing the armrest
armrest.a: You've had both armrests the whole film and my arm is hanging in the air. The middle seat gets the two, that's the rule.
armrest.b: I'm on the window side and my elbows need the room. I didn't realise there was a rule, I'll move over.

lateRsvp.title: ✉️ Answering the invitation at the last minute
lateRsvp.a: I asked everyone to reply by the first and you only said yes the day before. I'd already ordered the food for fifteen.
lateRsvp.b: I wasn't sure about my shift until then. One more person at the table can't hurt, and I brought a dessert.

thankYouNote.title: 💌 Thank-you notes
thankYouNote.a: Your cousin's wedding was a month ago and we haven't had a single word about our gift. A note costs nothing.
thankYouNote.b: They're probably still catching up on a hundred gifts. A message isn't the end of the world, give them time.

regift.title: 🎁 Regifting a present
regift.a: I found out the scarf I got from you was a present someone gave you first. I felt like it was an afterthought.
regift.b: It was lovely, and it didn't suit me. I thought it would suit you more, and I'd have given it to you anyway.

partyDrink.title: 🍾 Bringing something to the party
partyDrink.a: You showed up to dinner with nothing at all, and I'd cooked for two days. A bottle or some flowers would've been nice.
partyDrink.b: You said just bring yourself, and I took you at your word. I'll bring something good next time.

escalator.title: ⬆️ Standing on the escalator
escalator.a: You stood on the left side and blocked everyone who wanted to walk up. The rule is, stand right and walk left.
escalator.b: I'm carrying heavy bags and just want to get there safely. I don't have to hurry for anyone's schedule.

cinemaTalk.title: 🎞️ Whispering during the film
cinemaTalk.a: You explained every scene to your friend in a whisper all through the film. I paid to watch it, not to hear a running commentary.
cinemaTalk.b: She's new to the series and I was only helping her follow the plot. I'll stop if it really bothered you.

neighbourMusic.title: 🔈 A neighbour with a late party
neighbourMusic.a: Your party was still loud at one in the morning and some of us work in the morning. A little notice would've been polite.
neighbourMusic.b: I told the building, and it's one night a year. I'll ask people to move inside, but everyone's having fun.

socks.title: 🧦 Socks on the floor
socks.a: There's a pair of your socks next to the bed, another by the sofa and one in the hall. I pick them up every day.
socks.b: They're only socks and I'm going to wear them again. I'll put them in the basket, but you don't have to count them.

cafeSeat.title: ☕ Saving a seat with a laptop
cafeSeat.a: Your laptop has held that table for an hour and you've gone somewhere else. The place is full and people are standing.
cafeSeat.b: I only stepped out to take a call and I was coming straight back. Leaving a bag is how everyone saves a seat.

groupProject.title: 🎓 A group project nobody started
groupProject.a: The project is due in a week and I've written the whole outline alone. I need each of you to do your section by Friday.
groupProject.b: I have two exams before it and I told you my sections would come late. I can do them over the weekend.

puzzle.title: 🧩 Finishing my puzzle
puzzle.a: I'd been working on that puzzle for a week and you put in the last twenty pieces while I was out. I wanted to finish it myself.
puzzle.b: It was lying on the table and I got carried away. I didn't realise it meant so much to you, I'm sorry.

hedge.title: 🌿 The neighbour's hedge
hedge.a: Your hedge has grown over the path and I have to step into the road to get past. It's been like this since spring.
hedge.b: I've been meaning to trim it and the weather has been awful. I'll do it Sunday, you could have just knocked.
